claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; load once, set the context offline, reload, and assert the sample week

claim: Exports the log as comma-separated CSV text
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert the downloaded header and six sample rows

claim: Imports daily totals from CSV with required YYYY-MM-DD date and calories columns
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; import a one-row CSV and assert its totals and note

claim: Exports entries and settings as a JSON backup
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; parse the download and assert the sample entries and range

claim: Opens a printable view of the selected week
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; replace the browser print function and assert the action calls it

claim: Your log stays in this browser and demo data is separate
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; save an entry, assert only same-origin requests and only the demo IndexedDB name

claim: Has no ads, analytics, or third-party scripts
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; record all requests through a save flow and assert every script, frame, image, and request is same-origin

claim: Free, with no account or payment gate
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert there is no password field, purchase link, subscription, or payment copy

claim: Adds daily calories and optional macros, weight, and notes
sandbox: fresh 390px browser context at /demo; use the keyboard to edit and save a daily entry

claim: Saves a user-chosen calorie range, weight unit, and color theme, and preserves recorded weight meaning across unit changes
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; save a new range, pounds, and dark theme, reload, then assert all three persist and kilogram records display as converted pounds

claim: Uses the calorie range you choose and never suggests a target
where: landing boundary, settings dialog, terms, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; set a non-default minimum and maximum, then assert the review uses that exact range and the settings dialog states that it does not suggest one

claim: Does not show daily scores or judge a day
where: landing lede, landing boundary, footer, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; inspect every visible daily row and assert that no score, grade, or judgement control or value is shown

claim: Has no food search or coaching flow
sandbox: fresh browser context across the public and review routes; assert that no search landmark or input, food-search control, or coaching control is exposed

claim: Does not provide medical advice or diagnoses
sandbox: fresh browser context at /terms and /demo; assert the health boundary is shown and no advice, diagnosis, or recommendation control is exposed

claim: Imports entries and settings from a JSON backup
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; import a JSON backup with an entry and settings, then assert its total, range, unit, and theme

claim: Rejects invalid JSON backups without changing your log
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; import impossible-date and invalid-settings backups, then assert a field-specific recovery error and unchanged sample log

claim: Deletes the whole local log
where: landing privacy section, review tools, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; clear the isolated demo database and assert zero logged days

claim: Missing days stay blank and averages use only logged days
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert six logged days average to 2,062 and land inside the sample range

claim: The demo opens six sample days and one missing day with calorie, macro, weight, and note details
where: landing primary-action explanation, demo route, README
sandbox: fresh browser context at /; click Try it with sample data once and assert the demo banner, six logged days, missing Saturday, calorie and macro averages, weight trend, and notes

claim: Reset demo restores the original sample entries and settings
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; change an entry and settings, reset the demo, and assert six sample records and the 1,800–2,200 range return

claim: Starting for real discards demo data without changing the real log
sandbox: fresh browser context; seed the real database, change the demo, start for real, then assert the demo database is gone and the real record is unchanged

claim: Shows a seven-day calorie chart, logged-day average, macro averages, and weight trend
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; assert seven chart days, the 2,062 calorie average, protein/carbs/fat averages, and the three sample weight values
